# M3-14a: Slack and alerts in serve

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-14a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-14a`
- Depends on: M3-5, M3-10b, M3-12a
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/, config/
- Plan refs: §5 startup self-check, R11a, N2; STATE M1-4b (shutdown wait)
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`finbot serve` runs the Socket Mode client and sends freshness alerts after each sync, and shutdown can no longer hang.

## Scope
- Config: `SLACK_APP_TOKEN`, `SLACK_USERS` (`brendan:<slack id>,wife:<slack id>`), upserted into `users` at start. Socket Mode is off unless both and `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` are set. Errors name the variable, never the value. `SLACK_USERS` is already in the main `.env` (2 humans, set by sup): sup confirms, unprinted, that it has this shape before this task's tests use it, or tells the builder its shape.
- Add `SLACK_APP_TOKEN` and each Slack user id from `SLACK_USERS` to `secrets(cfg)` in `cmd/app.go`.
- Start the client under the serve ctx. A self-check failure raises a critical alert and is logged; the mirror keeps syncing.
- After each scheduled sync, feed `alerts/`. Outcomes never fail the sync job or touch `Health`.
- Bounded shutdown: every wait on shutdown (scheduler job, socket client, HTTP servers) shares a deadline. On expiry, log and exit, so a hung job can't hold the process.

## Out of scope
- The categorize job and `CLASSIFY_MODE` (M3-14b). Import status (M3-15). `deploy.sh` forwards (M3-17).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Config tests: all set, one missing (feature off), malformed `SLACK_USERS` names the variable and not the value.
- [ ] Test: the app token and both Slack user ids are scrubbed by the log redaction.
- [ ] Test: a job that ignores ctx doesn't stop `serve` from returning within the deadline.
- [ ] Test: an alert failure leaves the sync successful and `Health` unchanged.
- [ ] Test: a self-check failure sends a critical alert and sync continues.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
